content.user_title: Show Claude Router Usage and Savings
content.value_statement: Claude Router users need a clear view of routing volume, exception handling, and estimated savings. This skill reads the local router stats file and presents concise usage analytics.
actual_capabilities: Reads the local Claude Router stats file from the documented path.
Displays total routed queries and route distribution percentages.
Shows tool-aware routing, orchestrated query counts, and exception totals.
Calculates total savings from estimated and delegation savings values.
Summarizes the most recent session or daily usage details.
limitations: Requires an existing local router stats file.
Only reports fields that are present in the stats data.
Does not create, update, or repair router statistics.
Uses fixed cost assumptions from the skill instructions.

use_cases.title: Track routing adoption
use_cases.description: Review how many queries use fast, standard, deep, and orchestrated routes over time.

use_cases.title: Review savings for planning
use_cases.description: Summarize estimated cost savings before discussing AI usage budgets with a team.

use_cases.title: Support router configuration
use_cases.description: Check exception counts and routing mix when explaining router behavior to another user.

prompt_templates.title: Show router stats
prompt_templates.prompt: Use router-stats to display my Claude Router usage statistics.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize today
prompt_templates.prompt: Use router-stats and summarize today's routed queries, route distribution, exceptions, and savings.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze route mix
prompt_templates.prompt: Use router-stats to analyze my route distribution and explain which routes are driving savings.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare team report
prompt_templates.prompt: Use router-stats to produce a concise usage report for a team review, including totals, exceptions, assumptions, and missing data.

output_examples.output: The report lists total routed queries, route distribution percentages, exception counts, estimated savings, delegation savings, and today's session totals.
The summary shows estimated savings, delegation savings, total savings, and the pricing assumption used for comparison.

output_examples.input: What happens if there are no stats yet?
output_examples.output: The skill explains that no Claude Router stats are available yet and stops without creating a file.

best_practices: Invoke the skill only when you want local usage data displayed.
Review the stats file path before sharing reports from a managed machine.
Treat savings values as estimates based on stored assumptions.
anti_patterns: Do not use the report as a billing statement.
Do not ask the skill to edit or delete the stats file.
Do not publish output if it reveals private usage patterns.

faq.question: What file does this skill read?
faq.answer: It reads the local Claude Router stats file at the documented path in the skill instructions.

faq.question: Does it change my stats file?
faq.answer: No. The instructions only read the file and format the results for display.

faq.question: Can it calculate exact billing costs?
faq.answer: No. It reports estimates based on the stored data and fixed pricing assumptions.

faq.question: What if the stats file is missing?
faq.answer: The skill tells you that no stats are available yet.

faq.question: Does it send data to a server?
faq.answer: No network behavior is described in the skill instructions.

faq.question: Who benefits from this skill?
faq.answer: Claude Router users who want a concise usage and savings report benefit most.
